text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Japan Dirt Derby right around the 
corner, summer training camp with Smart 
Falcon has begun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She took on the turf course she struggles 
with at the Satsuki Sho for her fans. 
Next, it's time to show those fans her 
true strength on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything was for the fans who supported 
her. Smart Falcon psyched herself up with 
everything she had.
